facts.claim: ProofBox orchestrates 3 Vultr Serverless Inference models (nemotron-3.5-content-safety, deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017, qwen3.8-27b) across a 6-stage pipeline with 3.29s mean latency
Every task executes inside an unprivileged Docker container (uid=65534, --cap-drop=ALL, --network=none or SSRF-filtered, 0 secrets mounted) and is destroyed on exit
Achieved 100% (12/12) pass rate across external datasets, IANA web targets, and OWASP adversarial containment probes on Vultr Cloud Compute
Supports multi-node Kubernetes GPU training inside sandboxes
